pages.title: KubeJS Startup Check
pages.text: Auram cancels the unconditional startup update request in the supported KubeJS version. Script loading, lifecycle events and reloads still run.$(br2)The patch is optional when KubeJS is absent. It does not disable every mod’s independent update system.

pages.title: Pack Updates
pages.text: The Auram pack disables other update checks through Forge and individual mod config files. Those choices live in the pack, not in this book or a universal AuramCore toggle.$(br2)Use the pack’s normal update process. Restart after installing a new AuramCore jar so its code and mixins can load; a resource reload alone cannot apply Java code changes.
